newsitem.title: USA: Sallie Mae Q1 shr $2.17 vs $1.74. [CORRECTED 20:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Sallie Mae Q1 shr $2.17 vs $1.74. [CORRECTED 20:50 GMT]

text.p: NOTE: The pipeline of loans currently serviced and committed for purchase by Sallie Mae was $4.0 billion at March 31, essentially unchanged from year-end 1996.

Floor revenues represent additional income the corporation receives on certain loans in low interest rate environments. The corporation recognized as earnings $4.1 million ($0.08 per share), after-tax, of net floor revenues for the first quarter of 1997, down from $10 million ($0.17 per share) in the 1996 first quarter and $5.2 million ($0.09 per share) in the 1996 fourth quarter.
